name: part4_mac_final_evidence_freeze
safe_claims: 900/900 recorded policy invocations have unique global conditions.
Policy-local condition reuse reduces trace-visible condition ingress from 4,608,000 B to 460,800 B over the frozen 900-policy workload.
This is a 90% reduction, or a 10x condition-ingress ratio.
The same 90% / 10x relation holds for generic 64-, 128-, 256-, and 512-bit serialized memory interfaces.
EmbodiCore-759 resets scan state on all 9,000 independent scan calls.
Under the explicit no-reset RTL stress test, Agnostic-4087 produces 8,990 stale-condition uses and 8,999 illegal scan carries.
The real-weight archive contains 108 arrays across all 12 mixers.
Dynamic workload measurements are available only for mixers 0, 6, and 11.
No additional strong policy-local intermediate was observed among the nine available real microtrace arrays.
At the frozen 128-bit / scan-rate-8 reference point, legal condition reuse reduces representative-kernel serialized cycles by about 0.005990%.
Across the frozen sensitivity sweep, the representative cycle effect ranges from 0.001375% to 0.012095%.
Relative to Matched-NoReuse, the verified EmbodiCore semantic controller adds one generic LUT and zero FFs under both 4-LUT and 6-LUT Yosys/ABC mappings.
